selection_rule: No candidate may be preferred before parent reconstruction plus exact compensation-aware census. A candidate that collapses to UNIVERSAL_COMPUTATION_ONLY is demoted even if expressive.

candidates.idea: Typed local stateful transducers connected by a mutable graph; local transition kernels plus local/global update operators.
candidates.main_risk: May be only a universal graph computer with no intelligence-specific content.
candidates.kill_test: If all nontrivial results reduce to simulation and no ecology-conditioned learnability/resource prediction follows, return UNIVERSAL_COMPUTATION_ONLY.
candidates.why_keep: Most neutral candidate for morphology emergence and locality; does not hard-code neural weights or symbolic rules.

candidates.idea: Parameterized typed functions paired with update/request maps and monoidal composition, extended with explicit resource and topology-change semantics.
candidates.main_risk: Neural/differentiable bias may make symbolic/program/probabilistic derivations unnatural or simply encode them as opaque maps.
candidates.kill_test: If cross-paradigm compilation requires arbitrary black-box morphisms or unbounded hidden state, parent algebra is insufficient for Track-B residual.
candidates.why_keep: Best-developed compositional mathematics among candidates and therefore an important strongest-parent basis.

candidates.idea: Small typed instruction/rewrite primitives operating over a graph/program/state store; learning is governed graph/program rewrite and library formation.
candidates.main_risk: Almost certainly computationally universal; may merely re-encode every morphology as a program and explain nothing about emergence.
candidates.kill_test: Demand bounded developmental compilation and predictive phase results; representation-only success is UNIVERSAL_COMPUTATION_ONLY.
candidates.why_keep: Strong parent for explicit/programmatic cognition and a useful adversary to claims that local transducers are fundamental.

candidates.idea: Typed stochastic generative primitives plus conditioning/inference/update and compositional stochastic processes.
candidates.main_risk: Stochastic semantics may bake probabilistic intelligence into the basis and make deterministic/programmatic systems mere degenerate cases.
candidates.kill_test: If its only cross-paradigm story is 'deterministic systems are delta distributions', it has not explained morphology differences.
candidates.why_keep: Forces Track B to test whether uncertainty/inference is fundamental, derived, or ecology-specific rather than assuming determinism.

explicit_non_candidate.reason: u2 contains warrant/provenance/authority/lifecycle fields that may be valuable at morphology level but would bias the putative fundamental basis toward the current OCM design. It remains a Cognitive Asset Contract candidate, not the assumed atom.
